esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a separate 12 V supply for VIN (it needs 7–12 V and up to 250 mA, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x6d. Added the qwiic_quad_relay.py driver written from the datasheet.
Relays follow on/off/toggle-all commands and report their states: passes
